description: OverlayFS subsystem in Linux kernel fails to properly validate user namespace permissions during upperdir setting.
mitigation: Update Linux kernel to 5.11+ or patched distribution release.

description: Flaw in uninitialized page flags handling in pipe buffer structure allows overwriting read-only file data.
Out-of-bounds argument processing flaw in Polkit pkexec component.
mitigation: Update polkit package or remove SUID bit from pkexec (chmod 0755 /usr/bin/pkexec).

description: Use-after-free vulnerability in Linux kernel Netfilter nf_tables subsystem.
mitigation: Upgrade Linux kernel to 6.3.1+ or disable unprivileged user namespaces.
